## Accepted partial result and exact scope

Problem 30001812 / OWR-5158-013 remains unresolved after 5/5 substantive approaches. This target-only packet publishes the accepted corrected comparison

    ||alpha||_1 <= G_X(alpha) <= (v_8/v_3) ||alpha||_1

for every topological space X and every real third-homology class alpha. Here G is generated by exact finite real combinations of images of oriented closed connected 3-manifold fundamental classes, weighted by ordinary real simplicial volumes. v_3 and v_8 are the volumes of the regular ideal tetrahedron and octahedron. The factor is greater than one; the result does not establish equality, an optimal constant, or a strict counterexample.

The accepted supporting reductions are exact integral stabilization with torsion clearing; the finite-span rational-to-real passage; a sufficient isometric-realization criterion; the zero-cost surface-suspension example; the finite regularly coloured Delta-pseudomanifold witness equivalence; and the attained algebraic dual formula and bounded-cocycle criterion. The remaining bridge is a unit-cost realization or an explicit strict witness. Verification and publication add zero research turns. No novelty, exhaustive worldwide literature status, formal proof-assistant verification, conventional human refereeing or journal acceptance is claimed. The work and independent audit are AI-assisted.

## Corrections and full audit

The complete independent mathematical audit is retained byte for byte as current/INDEPENDENT_AUDIT.md. Its original authored manifest SHA-256 is b75bdd36e3bee3925309a23359bcb5be42ea29cc42e53f92b48d7735ac1a7b2a. All original manifest-listed authored proof and audit inputs were checked and remain unchanged.

The supplied current/CORRECTIONS.patch was applied to a staging copy with zero fuzz and zero offset. The three mathematical/checker postimages matched the audit's corrected copies exactly. The correction qualifies single connected-source rational realization by path connectedness; uses the symmetrization formula's rational output and its real chain homotopy, without attributing a separate rational homotopy to the source; states the finite-support and Delta-pseudomanifold conventions; preserves the finite-2-skeleton and hyperbolic-source hypotheses of other cited results; and replaces removable assertions with explicit exceptions.

The subsequent current/STATUS_UPDATE.patch changes only acceptance-status wording in the two current proofs and approach ledger. Reapplying both patches to unchanged originals reproduced all four delivered current files byte for byte. No equality, novelty or optimality assertion was added. Superseded full proofs and the unsafe original assertion checker are omitted instead of copied as padding. The full audit's historical descriptions remain intact.

## Sources and publication boundary

The exact problem is Clara Löh, *Functorial semi-norms in homology and mapping degrees*, [Oberwolfach Report 30/2011](https://ems.press/content/serial-article-files/46346), printed p. 1693, Theorem 32 and Question 5. Finiteness, rational realization and the limits of the higher-dimensional surgery route use Crowley–Löh, [*Functorial semi-norms on singular homology and (in)flexible manifolds*](https://loeh.app.uni-regensburg.de/preprints/funcseminorms.pdf), Theorem 3.1, Corollary 3.2, Theorem 4.2 and Proposition 4.3.

The normalization interface is Löh–Moraschini, [*Simplicial volume via normalised cycles*, arXiv:2003.02584v2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.02584v2), Lemmas 3.2–3.3. Its separate normalized-chain equality is not identified with the present generated seminorm. The coloured Delta-complex realization and exact Tomei constant use Lafont–Pittet, [*Comparing seminorms on homology*](https://people.math.osu.edu/lafont.1/pjm-259.pdf), pp. 376–377 and Lemma A.2, with Gaifullin's [2008 construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/0806.3580) and [2012 tile-count identity](https://arxiv.org/abs/1204.0208). The source-dependent, nonunit virtual-domination route and connected-sum calculations retain the hypotheses and limitations recorded in the full audit and historical source metadata.

Public source titles, URLs, PDF sizes and hashes, and historical retrieval/inspection scope are retained. They establish source-byte identity and provenance only. The publication stage makes no fresh source-retrieval or literature-search claim. historical/INPUT_MANIFEST.json identifies only public authored mathematical inputs; it is historical provenance, not a trust root or a fresh replay of omitted inputs. No copied source body, extracted third-party text, dataset content, private source, private coordination or identifying metadata for excluded private files is included.

The unsafe historical run_matrix.py, original assertion checker, full historical receipt, omitted superseded proof and optional original frozen-input replay are explicitly NOT_RUN by the fresh public verifier. Pre-seal capture-harness, source-body, new-source-search, dataset and formal-proof-assistant replay stages are also NOT_RUN. Historical audit statements about prior tests are historical evidence, not assertions that the omitted environment was recreated. Fresh sealed current-checker replay is distinct.

## Fresh finite diagnostics and separate delivery controls

Each isolated normal/-O/-OO suite runs the corrected author checker and unchanged independent audit checker. The independent positive has 80 exact chain cases; primary and disconnected fixtures have 120/240 tetrahedra, 240/480 face pairs, denominator 24, and l1 norms 5/10. Eleven actual algorithm/input mutants test signed averaging, its denominator, normalization, orientation, omitted face indices, colour preservation, missing/duplicate pairs, chain denominator, cover ratio and torsion multiplier. A separate actual 120-to-121 false-count mutation tests the corrected author's explicit exception. The adapter catches the intended exception before producing deterministic output; captured output is not rewritten or normalized.

Per mode there are two positive checker runs and twelve intended rejections: eleven algorithm/input mutants plus one exception guard. Across three modes there are six positives and 36 intended rejections. Hostile and integrity replays repeat these fixtures and add no mathematical coverage. Complete raw stdout/stderr and exit codes match fixed mode-specific references byte for byte, with recursively exact JSON types, identities, counts and rejection reasons. A bounded finite diagnostic subset is not a universal topological proof.

Each mode separately passes 48 delivery-integrity negatives, 61 schema/scope negatives, 30 exact-comparator negatives and 35 actual create/append-open/unlink permission denials at UID=EUID=1000. Hostile import and environment fixtures leave the complete baseline output unchanged. Complete delivered before/after snapshots match. These are distinct integrity controls, not additional mathematical mutants. Read-only modes deter accidental writes; they do not protect against root or deliberate owner chmod.

The target-only additive diff was applied in a fresh relocated directory, reproduced every delivered byte including empty stderr files, and passed normal/-O/-OO baseline replay with full output equality and unchanged snapshots.

## Reproduction and external trust

Independently authenticate BOOTSTRAP.py with the reviewed SHA-256 below and copy it outside the packet. With trusted CPython and standard library, actual UID=EUID=1000, all delivered files mode 0444 and all delivered directories mode 0555, run:

- python -I -S -B /trusted/BOOTSTRAP.py --controls /path/to/packet
- python -I -S -B -O /trusted/BOOTSTRAP.py --controls /path/to/packet
- python -I -S -B -OO /trusted/BOOTSTRAP.py --controls /path/to/packet

Omit --controls for baseline replay. The externally authenticated bootstrap pins the manifest, verifier and control harness before executing them. The exact noncircular manifest binds every other delivered byte, including the complete audit, corrected proof, contextual patches, historical public metadata, fixed finite contract, raw output references and pre-seal capture receipt. Bootstrap and manifest do not inventory themselves: the independently reviewed PR-body bootstrap pin anchors the chain. A pin learned solely from an untrusted packet does not authenticate it. Final external and relocated-diff receipts remain outside the packet and are pinned below; raw final-mode receipts are transitively pinned by their recorded lengths and SHA-256 hashes.

CPython 3.12.14 and its standard library are the execution dependencies; no third-party Python package is needed. Local preparation also used GNU patch 2.8 and Git 2.52.0; delivered final replay needs neither. Universal topology, source interfaces and all-space seminorm claims remain mathematical dependencies of the complete written proofs and audit.

Only unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30001812 is added. No QUEUE or unrelated path is changed. Draft only; no merge, release or publication outside this repository is requested. CI is not inferred from local diagnostics.
